reason: A Windows notification plugin that alerts users when Claude Code or DeepSeek Harness sessions need attention and supports click-to-return window activation.

summaries.zh: 为 Claude Code 和 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供 Windows 原生通知，并在点击通知时返回对应会话窗口。
summaries.en: Provides native Windows notifications for Claude Code and DeepSeek Harness sessions, with click-to-return activation for the associated session window.

capabilities: Displays native Windows toast notifications for session events
Receives Claude Code hook and DeepSeek Harness session events
Suppresses notifications based on session window focus
Activates the associated session window when a notification is clicked
Runs a local daemon and communicates over localhost HTTP
Writes local configuration and injects Claude Code hooks during installation
